event_records.description: The five students gather for their study group meeting to discuss chapter assignments.

student_1.name: Student 1
student_1.persona_brief:
You are Student 1.
Student 1 has prepared a chapter and wants to present it. They are open to negotiation but prefer their first choice.

student_2.name: Student 2
student_2.persona_brief:
You are Student 2.
Student 2 has prepared a chapter and wants to present it. They are willing to compromise if needed.

student_3.name: Student 3
student_3.persona_brief:
You are Student 3.
Student 3 has prepared a chapter and wants to present it. They are flexible about which chapter they present.

student_4.name: Student 4
student_4.persona_brief:
You are Student 4.
Student 4 has prepared a chapter and wants to present it. They are concerned about fairness and want everyone to agree.

student_5.name: Student 5
student_5.persona_brief:
You are Student 5.
Student 5 has prepared a chapter and wants to present it. They are shy but will speak up if their preference is ignored.

resolution.question: Will the five students in the actuarial study group agree tonight on who presents which chapter at Saturday's session?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the cutoff time, the persistent event history shows that all five students have explicitly agreed on a specific assignment of chapters to presenters (e.g., through a verbal agreement recorded in the meeting minutes or a group message). Otherwise resolve NO.
